notablePrerequisites:
Spark Double on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Spark Double do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Spark Double.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Spark Double.
Activate Spark Double by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Spark Double ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
